searchText: Thanks for that! also, is there any way Some applications on chain may be expecting state roots to be available every block so they can validate proofs. Changing this would break those apps. If you are asking in the abstract about a hypothetical blockchain not burdened by what is, I think a good way to suss out an answer is to ask what happens if you set `N` to infinity (only commit to state diffs, not state roots)? Git is diffs all the way down and seems to work reasonably well, but it can result in failing to notice a consensus error until long after the split occurred.
